messages:
Lina (Growth): quick update from NebulaCloud call 1: they want a co-marketed push when their marketplace listing goes live. thinking: joint blog + 1-hour technical webinar + paid social boost. want to confirm inbound handling and the benchmark angle before we say yes.
Ben (Partnerships): Nebula's target date is Nov 8. ask: can we do live demo of Redwood Private + marketplace provisioning, plus a short benchmark slide showing p95 latency and cost per 100k tokens? they want neutral wording.
Tariq (Product Marketing): neutral, production-first framing works. propose messaging pillars: 1) predictable p95 latency, 2) lower unit cost under sustained load, 3) frictionless marketplace provisioning. headline draft: "Deploy production LLM inference with predictable latency 1- click to Nebula Marketplace"
Eve (DemandGen): routing: where do Nebula marketplace referrals go? our HubSpot flows currently -> SFDC. prefer a tagged path so partner-sourced leads get partner SLA and dedicated follow-up (and separate nurture).
Ruth (Integrations): we can add a hidden field on the Nebula landing redirect partner_source=nebula_marketplace and UTM campaign utm_source=nebula&utm_campaign=nebula_market_launch. then webhook to HubSpot.
Noah (Sales Eng): for the webinar I can demo Dedicated routing + canary fallback + KV cache benefit. partner needs to provide a red-team workload profile (qps, typical token lengths). also request we keep a 10-min ops Q&A slot for customers.
Ben (Partnerships): will ask Nebula for workload sample and a 2-3 sentence quote. they also asked if we can co-fund a small social spend (they proposed $3k).
Lina (Growth): owners + rough deadlines:
- Partner quote & workload (Ben) -> due 10/18
- Final benchmark narrative (Tariq) -> due 10/22
- Landing page + hidden fields (Ruth) -> due 10/28
- Webinar deck + script (Noah + Tariq) -> due 11/02
- PR/blog draft (Eve) -> due 11/01
Eve (DemandGen): webinar format: 60m total; 30m partner product walkthrough, 15m Redwood demo, 15m live Q&A. landing page to include 'Request a trial' CTA that auto-tags.
Ruth (Integrations): proposed HubSpot mapping:
```
- landing -> HubSpot list: NB_Marketplace_Leads
- webinar signups -> HubSpot list: NB_Webinar_Signups
- hidden fields: partner_source=nebula_marketplace, utm_source=nebula, utm_campaign=nebula_market_launch
- HubSpot -> SFDC: Campaign=Nebula_Marketplace, Lead.Owner=Marketplace_SE_Queue
- MQL -> Sales queue + slack #inbound-partner-leads ping
```
Tariq (Product Marketing): benchmark guidance: show p50/p95 for token lengths of 32/256, plus cost per 100k tokens. show percent improvement vs 'public default infra' and include test notes (model, sequence, batch, quantization). avoid raw microbench claims.
Noah (Sales Eng): add note: label which tests used Dedicated vCPU/GPU configs so customers can reproduce. I'll put a short reproducibility appendix in the slides.
Ben (Partnerships): Nebula confirmed they will add the partner_source param on the marketplace redirect. they're fine with co-funded social but need a short copy + image from us.
Eve (DemandGen): landing form payload sample for the webhook (Ruth plz mirror):
```
{
  "email": "{{email}}",
  "first_name": "{{firstName}}",
  "company": "{{company}}",
  "partner_source": "nebula_marketplace",
  "utm_source": "nebula",
  "utm_campaign": "nebula_market_launch"
}
```
Ruth (Integrations): we'll also include a hidden field 'campaign_id' so SFDC campaign mapping is deterministic. will test in staging.
Lina (Growth): comms cadence suggestion: embargoed joint blog posted on Nov 8 morning, social blitz same day, webinar 2 weeks later (Nov 22). need final assets 72h before publish.
Tariq (Product Marketing): ok to do two benchmark variants for comms: 1) short claim for headline (percent improvement) 2) detailed appendix for blog and slides.
Eve (DemandGen): can Ops create rehearsal calendar 3 days before webinar? include tech check, slide run-through, partner cueing.
CalendarBot: created event "Nebula Marketplace joint webinar rehearsal" on Nov 19, 10:00-11:00 AM PT. Zoom: https://zoom.example.com/meet/nebula-rehearsal. Attendees: Lina, Ben, Tariq, Noah, Nebula reps.
Noah (Sales Eng): one more ask: include a clear CTA for 'Request a dedicated trial' that routes to a short intake form so we can fast-track POCs. Ruth, can that form set Lead.Owner=Marketplace_SE_Queue?
Ruth (Integrations): yes. I'll wire that up and add a test that pings #inbound-partner-leads when an intake form completes. target test in staging by 10/28.
Ben (Partnerships): will confirm partner assets (logo, quote) by Friday. also asked Nebula if they'd syndicate the webinar across their channels. they said yes.
Lina (Growth): great. I'll update the project board and create campaign in HubSpot once Ruth confirms field names. post any edits here. :rocket:
